items.title: Microsoft Edge Now Automatically Blocks Malicious Websites Sending Fake Virus Alert Notifications
items.description: Microsoft Edge now automatically disables notifications from websites that send users to detected scam pages, cutting off a route used to deliver fake virus warnings. The protection connects Microsoft Defender SmartScreen and Scareware blocker detections with notification permissions, helping prevent malicious sites from repeatedly drawing people back into the same scam. items.title: Google Issues Patches for Critical Android Flaw That Could Allow RCE Without User Interaction
items.description: A critical Android flaw could allow an attacker to run code on a phone without any user action remotely, Google said in its November security bulletin.
